Job Description: Full Stack Developer



Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Full Stack Developer with 2-4 years of experience to build scalable web
applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in both frontend and backend
technologies, along with a passion for clean code and problem-solving.
Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain web applications using modern frameworks and technologies
Design and implement responsive user interfaces
Build robust backend APIs and services
Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Design, QA, Product)
Optimize applications for maximum speed and scalability
Ensure code quality through testing and best practices
Troubleshoot and debug issues across the stack
Technical Skills Required
Frontend
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript
Experience with frameworks like React.js / Angular / Vue.js
Knowledge of responsive design and UI/UX principles
Backend
Experience in Node.js / Java / Python / .NET
Building RESTful APIs and microservices
Database
Hands-on experience with MySQL / PostgreSQL / MongoDB
Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Familiarity with version control systems (Git)


Experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP)
Strong communication and teamwork skills
